Rajnath Singh's statement on terrorism and India's global role

Defence Minister Rajnath Singh stated that India is prepared to take action against terrorism and will not compromise on its security. He also described India as a "civilisational power," asserting it is neither status quoist nor revisionist. Singh directed this message towards Pakistan.
